# Design -- rules and checks (generated from design.json; do not edit)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **status** | generated by build_kit.py; source of record is `angles/design.json` |
| **updated** | on every `build_kit.py` run |
| Purpose | Make the app look and read like the rest of the desktop in both themes and in a narrow pane. |
| Artifact | the Design row of APP.md; the design itself lands in the inline <style> of index.html, in surface.instructions, or in the row copy of a link |

## Questions

| id | question | required for | optional | v1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | When it opens, what is the first thing on the screen? | page | no | yes |
| D2 | Is it a table of rows, a few numbers, a short reading view, or one answer? | page | no | prefilled |
| D3 | Is anything on this page good, warning or blocked, and what makes it so? | page | no | prefilled |
| D4 | Who is this chat talking to, and what must it never say? | chat | no | yes |
| D5 | Does anything need to stay side by side when the window is narrow? | - | yes | no |
| D6 | What should the row say, and what does it look like next to the others? | link | no | yes |

## Rules

| id | rule | kinds | Sutra source | enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| DE-1 | Colour, type and radius come only from the injected tokens. No hex, rgb() or hsl(). The seed's token list is generated from TOKEN_CSS at payload time, never hand-typed. | page | modules_api.py TOKEN_CSS; static/panel.css :root | server prepends the token sheet; C10; constants-parity test |
| DE-2 | Five panel tokens are not injected and resolve to nothing: --shadow, --bubble, --th-bg, --knob, --vld-tx. | page | static/panel.css; modules_api.py TOKEN_CSS omits them | C10 names them in its failure text |
| DE-3 | The page never redefines the injected sheet: no :root, no html[data-theme], no #sutra-tokens selector. It must read in both themes. | page | modules_api.py page_html theme handling; static/js/18-modules.js theme query | C11; C36 renders both themes |
| DE-4 | One h1 at most, then h2, h3 in order, never skipping a level. The h1 names the content view, not the app. | page | skills/writing-style/SKILL.md one H1; APPS-DESIGN.md | C12 |
| DE-5 | Contrast comes from the pairings that already pass 4.5:1: --ink on --bg/--surface/--card, --muted for secondary prose, --on-acc on --acc. --faint is for crumbs, column heads and pills, never body text. | page | APPS-DESIGN.md contrast | guidance; C10 covers the hard half |
| DE-6 | The page draws no chrome of its own: no repeated app name, no tagline, no crumb, no kind or status pill. The header above it already carries all of that. | page | APPS-DESIGN.md header-only app view (D-M17); static/js/18-modules.js modAppViewHtml | C14 (advisory) |
| DE-7 | No animation is added. A transition that genuinely helps is under 150ms and disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. | page | APPS-DESIGN.md motion | C15 (advisory) |
| DE-8 | The page survives a narrow pane: one column by default, no fixed width or min-width above 320px, no sideways scroll. | page | APPS-DESIGN.md narrow pane; static/panel.css .dpage container query | C16 (advisory) |
| DE-9 | Chat instructions are a visible first message: a role line, at most eight short standing rules, one closing ask, 4000 characters maximum. | chat | modules_api.py INSTR_MAX; static/js/18-modules.js modOpenChat | server caps the length; C13 |
| DE-10 | A link has exactly one design decision, the row copy, and it borrows the screen it opens. The Design row of a link's record always reads that decision. | link | static/js/18-modules.js link row and Open control | C3 covers the row copy; C1 asserts the Design cell; C32 covers the target |

## Checks

| id | level | kinds | v1 | what | evaluator |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C10 | kind-required | page | must-fix | Every colour, font and radius value is var(--token), and every token named is one the server injects. | scan <style> blocks and style= attributes for colour/font/radius declarations with #rgb/#rrggbb/rgb(/hsl(/named colours outside a var() fallback; collect var(--name) and diff against the token set parsed from TOKEN_CSS; the five not-injected names are called out |
| C11 | kind-required | page | must-fix | The page does not redefine the injected sheet. | FAIL on :root{, :root ,, html[data-theme, or #sutra-tokens used as a selector |
| C12 | kind-required | page | suggest | At most one h1, headings in order, no skipped level. | census of h1..h6 in document order; FAIL when h1 count > 1 or a heading exceeds the previous level by more than one |
| C13 | kind-required | chat | suggest | The instructions read as a visible first message and fit the cap. | non-empty and len <= INSTR_MAX; first non-empty line ends in a full stop; at most eight lines beginning with a dash; last non-empty line contains ? or starts with Start by/Ask |
| C14 | advisory | page | suggest | The page does not repeat the header drawn above it. | WARN when name or tagline appears as heading or first paragraph text in the first 400 characters |
| C15 | advisory | page | suggest | No motion added, or motion disabled under reduced motion. | WARN when @keyframes, animation: or transition: appears and no prefers-reduced-motion block exists |
| C16 | advisory | page | suggest | Reads in a narrow pane with no sideways scrolling. | WARN on min-width above 320px, a container width/max-width in px above 360, white-space: nowrap over a table, or overflow-x: scroll; a 320px render probe when C36's runtime ran |
